description: This file defines the TensorFlowInferenceInterface class, which provides a wrapper for TensorFlow API components such as Graph and Session to facilitate inference operations in an Android environment. It includes methods for loading models, feeding inputs, running inference, and fetching outputs.

classes.name: TensorFlowInferenceInterface
classes.description: Provides an interface to load TensorFlow models, run inferences, and retrieve results in an Android context.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs inference with specified output node names, optionally enabling stats and specifying target nodes.

methods.name: graph
methods.description: Returns the TensorFlow computation graph associated with this interface.

methods.name: graphOperation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific operation/node from the graph by name.

methods.name: getStatString
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing the last run's statistics.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Releases resources associated with this interface, making it unusable afterward.

methods.name: feed
methods.description: Feeds input data to a named input node in the graph for different data types.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches output data from a named output node into a Java array or buffer.

methods.name: prepareNativeRuntime
methods.description: Loads native TensorFlow libraries if not already loaded.

methods.name: loadGraph
methods.description: Loads a serialized graph definition into a TensorFlow Graph object.
